quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "Drawing a hopscotch game with chalk"?
quests.hint: Think about when it's easiest to see chalk lines drawn on the sidewalk.
quests.explanation: Yes! Chalk games like hopscotch are played outside while it's light out.
quests.funFact: Hopscotch has been played by children for hundreds of years, all around the world!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "Skunks wandering near the garden fence in the dark"?
quests.hint: Think about the black-and-white striped animal known for exploring after dark.
quests.explanation: Yes! Skunks are nocturnal and usually come out to explore once it's dark.
quests.funFact: A skunk's famous spray is actually its clever way of staying safe from predators!

quests.instruction: "A lifeguard watching swimmers at the pool" — is this something we usually see in the Daytime or the Nighttime?
quests.hint: Think about when public pools are usually open for swimming.
quests.explanation: Yes! Lifeguards watch over swimmers while the pool is open during the day.
quests.funFact: Lifeguards train for a long time to learn how to rescue swimmers safely!

quests.instruction: "Sipping a warm cup of cocoa before climbing into bed" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about the warm, cozy drink some people enjoy right before sleep.
quests.explanation: Yes! A warm cup of cocoa is a cozy treat enjoyed just before bed.
quests.funFact: Warm drinks like cocoa can help your body feel relaxed and ready for sleep!

quests.instruction: You notice this happening: "Chickens pecking at seeds in the yard". What time of day is it?
quests.hint: Think about when chickens are usually out and about, looking for food.
quests.explanation: Yes! Chickens are active and pecking for food during the day.
quests.funFact: Chickens actually go back to their coop on their own once it starts getting dark!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "The whole neighborhood growing dark and calm"?
quests.hint: Think about how a busy neighborhood looks once everyone heads indoors to sleep.
quests.explanation: Yes! Neighborhoods grow dark and calm once the sun has set and people settle in.
quests.funFact: A calm, quiet neighborhood can help everyone sleep more peacefully!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "Shopping for fresh vegetables at a farmers market"?
quests.hint: Think about when farmers markets are usually open for shoppers.
quests.explanation: Yes! Farmers markets are typically open and busy during the day.
quests.funFact: Shopping at a farmers market helps support local farmers in your community!

quests.instruction: "A shooting star streaking across a black sky" — is this something we usually see in the Daytime or the Nighttime?
quests.hint: Think about when the sky is dark enough to spot a bright streak of light.
quests.explanation: Yes! Shooting stars can only be seen against a dark sky.
quests.funFact: A 'shooting star' isn't really a star at all — it's a tiny piece of rock burning up!

quests.instruction: "Riding a scooter around the block" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about when it's easiest and safest to ride outside.
quests.explanation: Yes! Riding a scooter outside is easiest and safest while it's light out.
quests.funFact: The very first scooters were built using old roller skate wheels!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "A candlelit dinner table, long after the sun has gone down"?
quests.hint: Think about what the phrase 'long after the sun has gone down' is telling you.
quests.explanation: Yes! This meal happens well after sunset, once it's dark outside.
quests.funFact: Candles were one of the very first ways people lit their homes after dark!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "A soccer game on the school field"?
quests.hint: Think about when school sports and games are usually played.
quests.explanation: Yes! Most school sports games are played during the day.
quests.funFact: Soccer is the most popular sport in the entire world!

quests.instruction: "Wolves howling somewhere in the distance" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about when wolves are usually most active, calling out to each other.
quests.explanation: Yes! Wolves are often most active and vocal after dark.
quests.funFact: Wolves howl to talk to each other across long distances in the forest!

quests.instruction: "Washing muddy boots after playing outside" — is this something we usually see in the Daytime or the Nighttime?
quests.hint: Think about when children usually come inside after a day of outdoor play.
quests.explanation: Yes! Cleaning up muddy boots usually happens after a day of playing outside.
quests.funFact: Rubber boots were invented to help keep feet dry in mud and puddles!

quests.instruction: You notice this happening: "A parent peeking in to check on a sleeping child". What time of day is it?
quests.hint: Think about when a child would already be asleep for a parent to check on them.
quests.explanation: Yes! This gentle check-in happens once a child is already asleep for the night.
quests.funFact: Many parents do a quiet check-in just to make sure everyone is safe and cozy!

quests.instruction: You notice this happening: "A hot air balloon floating over the hills". What time of day is it?
quests.hint: Think about when pilots need clear light to see where they are flying.
quests.explanation: Yes! Hot air balloons usually fly during the day, when pilots can see clearly.
quests.funFact: Hot air balloons float because the hot air inside is lighter than the cool air outside!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "The last bit of orange sky fading into darkness"?
quests.hint: Think about what 'fading into darkness' tells you about what's about to happen.
quests.explanation: Yes! Once the orange sky fades into darkness, the night has fully begun.
quests.funFact: The sky glows orange at sunset because sunlight scatters differently near the horizon!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "Sorting the recycling bins at the curb"?
quests.hint: Think about when trucks usually come by to collect the bins.
quests.explanation: Yes! Recycling and trash are usually collected during the day.
quests.funFact: Recycling one aluminum can saves enough energy to power a TV for three hours!

quests.instruction: "A cozy fire glowing in the fireplace" — is this something we usually see in the Daytime or the Nighttime?
quests.hint: Think about when families usually gather around a warm fireplace to relax.
quests.explanation: Yes! Families often gather by a cozy fire in the evening to relax together.
quests.funFact: Fireplaces have been used to warm and light homes for thousands of years!

quests.instruction: "A marching band practicing in the school yard" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about when school activities and practices usually take place.
quests.explanation: Yes! Marching band practice is a daytime school activity.
quests.funFact: Marching bands have to memorize both their music and their marching steps!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "Locking up the family bicycle in the garage before heading inside"?
quests.hint: Think about the last outdoor chore families finish before settling in for the evening.
quests.explanation: Yes! Putting things away for the evening is one of the last outdoor chores of the day.
quests.funFact: Bicycle locks were invented to help keep bikes safe when left outside!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "Chasing after a bouncing beach ball"?
quests.hint: Think about when families usually spend time outside playing at the beach.
quests.explanation: Yes! Playing with a beach ball is a fun outdoor activity enjoyed in daylight.
quests.funFact: The very first beach balls were made from rubber, over 100 years ago!

quests.instruction: "A possum wandering across the backyard in the dark" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about the small, slow animal known for exploring once it's dark outside.
quests.explanation: Yes! Possums are nocturnal and usually wander around after dark.
quests.funFact: A possum sometimes plays dead to trick animals that might want to bother it!

quests.instruction: "A garden hose left running by the flowerbeds" — is this something we usually see in the Daytime or the Nighttime?
quests.hint: Think about when people usually water their gardens.
quests.explanation: Yes! Watering the garden is a chore usually done during the day.
quests.funFact: Watering plants in the cooler morning helps them soak up water before the sun gets too hot!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "The television glowing softly in a dim, quiet living room"?
quests.hint: Think about when a room would be dim and quiet enough for a glowing screen to stand out.
quests.explanation: Yes! A softly glowing television in a dim room suggests it's evening or later.
quests.funFact: Old televisions used to only show shows in black and white, not color!

quests.instruction: You notice this happening: "Collecting fresh eggs from the henhouse". What time of day is it?
quests.hint: Think about when farmers usually visit the henhouse to gather eggs.
quests.explanation: Yes! Farmers usually collect fresh eggs in the morning.
quests.funFact: A single hen can lay about one egg almost every single day!

quests.instruction: "Glow-in-the-dark stars glowing softly on a bedroom ceiling" — is this something we usually see in the Daytime or the Nighttime?
quests.hint: Think about what these special stars actually need to glow: darkness!
quests.explanation: Yes! Glow-in-the-dark stars only glow once a room is dark, so this happens after lights go out.
quests.funFact: These stars soak up light during the day, then slowly release a soft glow after dark!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "A yellow school bus parked outside the school"?
quests.hint: Think about when school buses arrive to drop off students.
quests.explanation: Yes! School buses arrive and wait outside during school hours.
quests.funFact: School buses are painted this bright color because it's easy to spot from far away!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "A sleepy dog curling up by the fireplace"?
quests.hint: Think about when a warm fireplace would be lit and cozy for a nap.
quests.explanation: Yes! Dogs often curl up by a warm fireplace in the evening to rest.
quests.funFact: Dogs often circle around a few times before lying down — it's an old instinct!

quests.instruction: "Painting a fence a bright new color" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about when it's easiest to see the paint colors clearly while working.
quests.explanation: Yes! Outdoor painting projects are usually done during the day, in good light.
quests.funFact: Paint needs plenty of light and warmth to dry evenly outdoors!

quests.instruction: "Turning the pillow to its cool side before drifting off to sleep" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about the little habit some people have right as they're falling asleep.
quests.explanation: Yes! This cozy little habit happens right as someone is drifting off to sleep.
quests.funFact: A cooler pillow can actually help some people fall asleep faster!
